subject: Bespoke PO labeling & net-term laddering — NovusHealth procurement questions
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: PO template + invoicing cadence question

Hi Jordan / Vanessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week — Novus is excited about Dedicated capacity for our patient-data workloads. Our procurement team has a couple of practical constraints before we can finalize the PO:

- We need to show line-item-level PO IDs that map to individual legal entities (we have 3 entities that will be charged). Can Redwood accept multiple PO numbers on a single invoice or do you require separate invoices per PO?
- Net terms: our default is Net60 but we can move to Net45 if needed. Does Redwood have flexibility on Net terms for enterprise contracts? Any early-pay discount options?
- Invoice cadence: monthly preferred, but our AR team sometimes requests weekly settlements for specific projects. Can you do monthly consolidated invoices with a weekly statement extract?

I attached our internal PO template (Novus_PO_Template_v3.pdf) to show the fields we need populated. Also, on discounts — our finance lead flagged that we need any multi-entity / multi-PO processing to be explicitly called out before we lock a first-year discount.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of what you can support so we can prepare our internal sign-off.

Best,
Liam
Liam Chen 
Head of Strategic Sourcing
NovusHealth
Attachments: Novus_PO_Template_v3.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha.procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence question

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the template and the clear list. Quick answers up front, then a few asks so we can produce a formal appendix: 

- Multiple PO numbers on one invoice: we can support that. We will include PO-level line items and a PO mapping section on the invoice PDF/CSV so your AP can reconcile by entity.
- Net terms: standard for enterprise customers is Net45. We can offer Net60 for customers that require it, but that typically requires either (a) an annual prepay or (b) a short-term finance surcharge. We can outline exact options in the contract appendix.
- Invoice cadence: we can deliver consolidated monthly invoices and provide a weekly statement export (CSV) that breaks activity down by PO/PO line.

On discounts and packaging: if Novus commits to a 12-month reserved capacity baseline (dedicated pool), we can structure a stepped discount: 5% year-one off list for a single-entity contract; for multi-entity billing we'll treat the consolidated ARR for discounting but will require a single commercial agreement and an appendix that lists each legal entity and PO mapping. If you need independent entity-level discounts, we'll need separate SOWs/commitments per entity.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll draft a one-page procurement appendix that specifies PO field population, invoice layout, and acceptable XML/CSV PO formats.
- Vanessa, can you confirm whether we can offer Net60 with a 1.5% early-pay discount (if Novus prepays 30 days) or whether we prefer a finance surcharge?

Liam — can you share an example of an XML PO export (so our billing team can validate mapping)? Also confirm whether tax-exempt certificates will be provided per entity.

Thanks — attaching the current SOW excerpt so we can cite invoice itemization (SOW_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf).

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence question

Jordan / Liam — looping in Ben for billing ops nuance. Some practical negotiation points from commercial/finance: 

- Net terms flexibility: we can accept Net60 for Novus without a finance surcharge if Novus increases the annual committed spend threshold to USD 1.2M (across entities consolidated). If Novus wants Net60 at current commitment levels, we can do Net60 + 1% fee.

- Early-pay discount: 1.5% for payment within 15 days on monthly invoices is an option, but that requires PSR (pre-specified rebate) in the commercial appendix. We prefer the early-pay as a rebate rather than up-front credit.

- Multi-PO / multi-entity handling: operationally the cleanest path is a single master agreement with an appendix listing each entity and associated PO prefixes. Invoices will carry a PO mapping table and a per-PO line reference. We can accommodate your XML (see example rows below) and produce a reconciliation CSV with fields: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, entity_id, line_item, amount_usd.

- Discounting for packaging: we can offer a blended 6% first-year discount if Novus commits to a 12-month reserved pool and allows Redwood to consolidate billing per the master agreement (i.e., Redwood invoices centrally and Novus routes internally). If Novus requires separate invoices per legal entity, discount drops to 3% due to increased ops overhead.

Ben — can you confirm the technical spec for the invoice CSV layout and whether we can include a tax_exempt flag column?

Liam — once you confirm the commercial preference (consolidated invoice + master agreement OR per-entity invoices), Jordan and I will prepare the procurement appendix and a sample invoice export for your AP team to validate.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Asha Rao <asha.procure@novushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence question

Hi all — appreciate the clarity. Asha from Novus procurement here. Quick confirmations and asks: 

- Novus prefers consolidated billing with per-PO line mapping (single master agreement + appendix). That would make internal chargebacks easier.
- We are willing to move to the 12-month reserved commitment to qualify for the higher blended discount, but procurement needs the appendix and a sample invoice CSV to validate with our AR system before final approval.
- Tax-exempt: each legal entity will provide their tax exemption cert. We need you to include a tax_exempt boolean column in the CSV as Vanessa suggested.
- Net terms: we can accept Net60 only if the 1% fee is waived by applying the blended 6% first-year discount; otherwise we prefer Net45. (Finance team will weigh in if early-pay 1.5% is attractive.)

Attached is a small XML PO export example (NH_PO_45321.xml) reflecting our three entities and numbering scheme. Please draft the procurement appendix and a sample invoice export (CSV + PDF layout) and send by Friday EOD.

On the discount mechanics: please include the discount as a line-level credit on the invoice (so it shows per PO) rather than a lump-sum at the invoice bottom. That makes reconciliation simpler for us.

Best,
Asha Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
NovusHealth
Attachments: NH_PO_45321.xml
